id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description: The specification used for retrieving data displayed by the definition list.

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

dataRecord.description: Holds the data to display in the definition list.

orientation.description: Specify whether to show definitions horizontally or vertically.

equalWidth.description: Configuration to set the elements of the definition list to the same width. Only applicable when orientation is set to 'HORIZONTAL'.

ordering.description:
Specifies the ordering of the definition list items.

Possible values:
- 'OFF': No ordering is applied.
- 'ORDERED': The items are ordered using numbers.
- 'UNORDERED': The items are unordered using bullet points.
